pdf.name: PDF
pdf.description: Merge, split, compress, convert and secure PDFs.

images.name: Images
images.description: Convert, compress, resize and clean up images.

audio.name: Audio
audio.description: Convert, trim, normalize, transcribe and synthesize sound.

video.name: Video
video.description: Convert, compress, trim and subtitle videos.

text.name: Text & Documents
text.description: Analyze, clean up, compare and transform text.

files.name: Files & Archives
files.description: Compress, extract, compare, rename and organize files.

converters.name: Converters
converters.description: Go from one format to another, whatever the file type.

developer.name: Developer
developer.description: Format, encode, generate and inspect technical formats.

calculators.name: Calculators
calculators.description: Units, percentages, dates, durations and everyday math.

network.name: Network
network.description: Diagnose a connection, test ports, see what's plugged into your home network.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics & Recovery
diagnostics.description: Understand what's broken in a damaged file, and rescue what can be saved.

security.name: Security & Privacy
security.description: Passwords, encryption, hashes and data erasure.

pdf-merge.name: Merge PDFs
pdf-merge.description: Combine several PDFs into a single document, in the order you choose.

pdf-split.name: Split a PDF
pdf-split.description: Cut a PDF into several files by page ranges.

pdf-extract-pages.name: Extract pages
pdf-extract-pages.description: Create a new PDF from a selection of pages.

pdf-remove-pages.name: Remove pages
pdf-remove-pages.description: Permanently remove some pages from a PDF.

pdf-reorder-pages.name: Reorder pages
pdf-reorder-pages.description: Change the page order with drag and drop.

pdf-rotate.name: Rotate pages
pdf-rotate.description: Turn all or some pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

pdf-compress.name: Compress a PDF
pdf-compress.description: Reduce a PDF's file size while keeping it easy to read.

images-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.description: Turn a series of images into a paginated PDF document.

pdf-to-images.name: PDF to images
pdf-to-images.description: Export each page of a PDF as PNG or JPEG, at the resolution you want.

document-to-pdf.name: Document to PDF
document-to-pdf.description: Convert a text, Markdown or HTML file to PDF.

pdf-add-text.name: Add text
pdf-add-text.description: Write text on a PDF to fill in a form or annotate it.

pdf-add-image.name: Add an image or signature
pdf-add-image.description: Insert an image, a stamp or a signature exactly where you want.

pdf-watermark.name: Add a watermark
pdf-watermark.description: Stamp a text watermark on all or some pages.

pdf-page-numbers.name: Number pages
pdf-page-numbers.description: Add customizable page numbers in the header or footer.

pdf-protect.name: Password-protect
pdf-protect.description: Encrypt a PDF so it only opens with a password.

pdf-unlock.name: Unlock a PDF
pdf-unlock.description: Remove the protection from a PDF whose password you know.
pdf-unlock.note: FourTout doesn't break protections: you need to know the password. For a forgotten password, see “Recover a PDF password”.

pdf-recover-password.name: Recover a PDF password
pdf-recover-password.description: Try likely passwords to reopen a PDF whose password you've forgotten.
pdf-recover-password.note: Local recovery using a dictionary and rules, on a document you're authorized to open. It isn't an exhaustive search: a password that isn't in the word list won't be found.

pdf-metadata.name: PDF metadata
pdf-metadata.description: Read and edit a PDF's title, author, subject and keywords.

pdf-extract-images.name: Extract images from a PDF
pdf-extract-images.description: Get back every image embedded in a PDF.

pdf-extract-text.name: Extract text from a PDF
pdf-extract-text.description: Get the selectable text of a PDF, page by page.

pdf-edit-text.name: Edit PDF text
pdf-edit-text.description: Fix text right on the page: double-click a word and replace it.
pdf-edit-text.note: Visual editing by replacement: the original text is covered with the sampled background color, then redrawn. Best for horizontal text on a plain background (documents, invoices, reports). Areas on a non-uniform background or rotated text are flagged and left unchanged.

ocr-document.name: OCR a scanned PDF
ocr-document.description: Recognize the text in a scanned PDF, page by page, in French or English.
ocr-document.note: Local OCR engine (tesseract.js) bundled with the app: no data is sent over the network. For a single image, see “Extract text from an image”.

pdf-compare.name: Compare two PDFs
pdf-compare.description: Highlight the differences between two versions of a document.

pdf-redact.name: Redact a PDF
pdf-redact.description: Permanently hide sensitive areas: content is removed, not just covered.

pdf-searchable.name: Scanned PDF to searchable PDF
pdf-searchable.description: Recognize the text of a scanned PDF and add it as an invisible layer: Ctrl+F, selection and copy work, and the appearance doesn't change.
pdf-searchable.note: Recognition is entirely local. The original pages are neither rasterized nor recompressed: only an invisible text layer is added. Result quality depends on the quality of the scan.

pdf-extract-tables.name: Extract tables from a PDF
pdf-extract-tables.description: Rebuild rows and columns from the position of the text, then export to CSV or an XLSX workbook.
pdf-extract-tables.note: A PDF doesn't contain tables, only positioned text: FourTout rebuilds rows and columns from those positions. Complex tables — merged cells, text over several lines — may need corrections before export.

scans-to-pdf.name: Scans and photos to PDF
scans-to-pdf.description: Combine scanned or photographed pages into a single PDF, with cleanup and page ordering.
scans-to-pdf.note: Cleanup applies to every page with the same settings; assembly reuses the “Images to PDF” engine.

image-convert.name: Convert an image
image-convert.description: Go from one format to another: PNG, JPG, WebP. Also reads GIF, BMP, TIFF and SVG.

image-compress.name: Compress an image
image-compress.description: Reduce an image's file size while controlling quality loss.

image-resize.name: Resize an image
image-resize.description: Change the dimensions in pixels or percent, with or without keeping the ratio.

image-crop.name: Crop an image
image-crop.description: Crop an image visually, freely or to a ratio (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:2).

image-rotate.name: Rotate and mirror
image-rotate.description: Rotate by quarter turns and mirror, with an instant preview.

image-flip.name: Flip horizontally or vertically
image-flip.description: Flip an image as if in a mirror.

image-grayscale.name: Black and white
image-grayscale.description: Convert to grayscale, or to pure black and white with an adjustable threshold.

image-adjust.name: Adjust an image
image-adjust.description: Tune brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma, with a live preview.

image-blur.name: Blur or pixelate
image-blur.description: Hide information: blur or mosaic, on the whole image or a drawn area.

image-remove-transparency.name: Remove transparency
image-remove-transparency.description: Flatten a transparent PNG or WebP onto a solid background (white, black or a color).

image-remove-background.name: Remove background
image-remove-background.description: Automatically cut out the subject of a photo and make the background transparent.
image-remove-background.note: The cutout model is installed once from Settings → Models, then works offline: the image is never sent to a server. It recognizes a sharp, well-separated main subject; it gets things wrong on scenes without an obvious subject and on very fine details.

image-color-transparent.name: Make a color transparent
image-color-transparent.description: Erase a solid color (such as the background) and replace it with transparency.

image-ocr.name: Extract text from an image (OCR)
image-ocr.description: Recognize the text in an image, in French or English, 100% locally.

image-add-text.name: Text on an image
image-add-text.description: Write text on an image — caption, meme, annotation — and place it by hand.

image-metadata-read.name: Read image metadata
image-metadata-read.description: Show EXIF, GPS, camera and capture date.

image-metadata-strip.name: Remove image metadata
image-metadata-strip.description: Erase EXIF and GPS data before sharing a photo.

image-batch-convert.name: Batch image conversion
image-batch-convert.description: Apply the same conversion to a whole folder of images.

image-watermark.name: Image watermark
image-watermark.description: Add a logo or text watermark, one image at a time or in batches.

image-favicon.name: Generate a favicon
image-favicon.description: Create a multi-size favicon and the .ico file from an image.

image-icon-sizes.name: Generate multiple sizes
image-icon-sizes.description: Export every useful icon or thumbnail size in one go.

color-picker.name: Analyze and convert a color
color-picker.description: Dominant colors of an image, pixel-precise eyedropper, HEX / RGB / HSL / HSV notations, and WCAG contrast between text and its background.

document-perspective.name: Fix document perspective
document-perspective.description: Straighten a photo of a page taken at an angle: place the four corners and FourTout turns it back into a rectangle seen head-on.
document-perspective.note: The four corners are placed by hand: it's always exact, where automatic detection gets it wrong. Proportions inferred from the corners are approximate — force A4 or Letter for an exact result.

scan-clean.name: Clean up a scan
scan-clean.description: Straighten a slightly tilted document, boost contrast, whiten a gray or yellowed background, convert to grayscale or black and white.
scan-clean.note: Each setting is optional and shown in a before/after preview. Whitening never touches dark pixels: fine text keeps its density.

image-compare.name: Compare two images
image-compare.description: See and measure what changes between two images: side by side, overlaid or as a difference, with differing pixels, PSNR and SSIM.
image-compare.note: Two images of different sizes are never resized without your consent: resampling would create differences that aren't in the files.

image-contact-sheet.name: Create a contact sheet
image-contact-sheet.description: Lay out several images in a grid on a single sheet, with each file's name.

audio-record.name: Record from the microphone
audio-record.description: Capture sound from the microphone and save it locally.

audio-trim.name: Trim audio
audio-trim.description: Keep a precise excerpt of an audio file.

audio-merge.name: Merge audio files
audio-merge.description: Put several tracks end to end in a single file.

audio-convert.name: Convert audio
audio-convert.description: Go from one format to another: MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, OPUS.

audio-compress.name: Compress audio
audio-compress.description: Reduce an audio file's size by adjusting the bitrate.

audio-volume.name: Change volume
audio-volume.description: Raise or lower the overall volume of an audio file.

audio-normalize.name: Normalize audio
audio-normalize.description: Even out the loudness of several files.

audio-speed.name: Change speed
audio-speed.description: Speed up or slow down audio, with or without pitch correction.

audio-remove-silence.name: Remove silence
audio-remove-silence.description: Automatically detect and cut the gaps in a recording.

video-extract-audio.name: Extract audio from a video
video-extract-audio.description: Get a video's soundtrack in the format of your choice.

audio-transcribe.name: Audio transcription
audio-transcribe.description: Turn speech in an audio or video file into text, locally.
audio-transcribe.note: Speech recognition model running on your machine, installed on demand.

audio-generate-srt.name: Generate SRT subtitles
audio-generate-srt.description: Create a timestamped subtitle file from audio or video.

text-to-speech.name: Text to speech
text-to-speech.description: Read text aloud and save it as an audio file, without any online service.
keywords: make an mp3 from my text

pdf-to-audio.name: PDF to audio
pdf-to-audio.description: Turn a PDF into an audiobook using local speech synthesis.

text-file-to-audio.name: Text file to audio
text-file-to-audio.description: Convert a TXT or Markdown file into a narrated audio file.
keywords: make an mp3 from my text

audio-channels.name: Convert audio channels
audio-channels.description: Switch a file to mono or stereo, or leave it as is. A multichannel file is never downmixed unless you ask.
audio-channels.note: From mono to stereo, the channel is duplicated: both sides carry the same signal. No spatialization is invented.

audio-metadata.name: Edit audio tags
audio-metadata.description: Read and fix title, artist, album, year, genre, track and comment — without re-encoding the sound.
audio-metadata.note: Writing copies the audio stream as is (-c copy): the resulting sound is bit-for-bit identical.

media-info.name: Inspect a media file
media-info.description: Everything an audio or video file declares: container, codecs, resolution, frame rate, bitrates, channels, tags.

video-convert.name: Convert a video
video-convert.description: Go from one format to another: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV.
video-convert.note: Only codecs actually available in the installed engine are offered.

video-compress.name: Compress a video
video-compress.description: Drastically reduce a video's file size by choosing the target quality.

video-resolution.name: Change resolution
video-resolution.description: Convert a video to 1080p, 720p, 480p or a custom size.

video-trim.name: Trim a video
video-trim.description: Keep just an excerpt, without re-encoding whenever possible.

video-merge.name: Merge videos
video-merge.description: Join several videos end to end into a single file.

video-crop.name: Crop a video
video-crop.description: Visually select the area to keep, with fixed proportions.

video-to-gif.name: Video to GIF
video-to-gif.description: Turn a video clip into an optimized animated GIF.

gif-to-video.name: GIF to video
gif-to-video.description: Convert an animated GIF to MP4 or WebM, which is much lighter.

video-extract-frame.name: Extract a frame from a video
video-extract-frame.description: Capture a specific frame or take snapshots at regular intervals.

video-speed.name: Change video speed
video-speed.description: Create a time-lapse or slow motion, audio included.

video-rotate.name: Rotate a video
video-rotate.description: Fix a video filmed the wrong way round, or mirror it.

video-remove-audio.name: Remove sound from a video
video-remove-audio.description: Create a silent version of the video, without re-encoding the picture.

video-replace-audio.name: Replace the audio track
video-replace-audio.description: Replace a video's soundtrack, or add an extra track to it.
video-replace-audio.note: Drop the video and the audio file together.

video-volume.name: Change video volume
video-volume.description: Turn a video's sound up or down without touching the picture.

video-add-subtitles.name: Add a subtitle track
video-add-subtitles.description: Attach an SRT or VTT file to the video, which can be turned on in the player.
video-add-subtitles.note: Drop the video and the subtitle file together.

video-burn-subtitles.name: Burn in subtitles
video-burn-subtitles.description: Burn subtitles into the picture so they show in every player.
video-burn-subtitles.note: Drop the video and the subtitle file together.

video-extract-subtitles.name: Extract subtitles from a video
video-extract-subtitles.description: Export existing subtitle tracks as SRT or VTT.
video-extract-subtitles.note: Only text tracks can be exported; image-based tracks (PGS, DVD) are pictures.

video-generate-subtitles.name: Generate subtitles for a video
video-generate-subtitles.description: Automatically transcribe a video's speech, then export or burn in the subtitles.
video-generate-subtitles.note: Uses the local transcription model already installed (nothing is sent over the network).

video-batch.name: Batch video processing
video-batch.description: Convert, compress, resize, rotate or extract the audio of several videos.

video-frame-rate.name: Change frame rate
video-frame-rate.description: Convert a video to 24, 25, 30 or 60 fps or a custom rate, by duplicating and dropping frames.
video-frame-rate.note: No in-between frames are computed: frames are duplicated or dropped. The output has a constant frame rate.

text-statistics.name: Word and character counter
text-statistics.description: Words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and estimated reading time.

text-case.name: Change case
text-case.description: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case.

text-clean.name: Clean up text
text-clean.description: Remove extra spaces, blank lines, tabs and invisible characters.

text-find-replace.name: Find and replace
text-find-replace.description: Replace text in bulk, with or without a regular expression.

text-compare.name: Compare two texts
text-compare.description: See line by line what was added, removed or changed.

text-deduplicate.name: Remove duplicates
text-deduplicate.description: Keep only one occurrence of each line, optionally ignoring case.

text-sort-lines.name: Sort lines
text-sort-lines.description: Sort lines alphabetically, numerically or randomly.

markdown-convert.name: Markdown ↔ HTML / text
markdown-convert.description: Convert Markdown to HTML or plain text, and back.

text-extract-urls.name: Extract URLs
text-extract-urls.description: Get every web address contained in a text.

text-extract-emails.name: Extract email addresses
text-extract-emails.description: Pull out every email address in a text.

text-extract-numbers.name: Extract numbers
text-extract-numbers.description: Pull every number out of a text and add them up.

lorem-ipsum.name: Lorem Ipsum
lorem-ipsum.description: Generate dummy text: words, sentences or paragraphs.

text-unicode-normalize.name: Normalize Unicode
text-unicode-normalize.description: Make accents consistent across systems (NFC, NFD, NFKC, NFKD).

text-line-endings.name: Convert line endings
text-line-endings.description: Switch from CRLF (Windows) to LF (Unix) and back, with detection first.

docx-extract.name: Word (DOCX) to text, Markdown or HTML
docx-extract.description: Extract the content of a Word document: headings, paragraphs, lists and tables.
docx-extract.note: Complex layout (columns, images, styles) isn't reproduced: FourTout extracts the content and its structure.

docx-to-pdf.name: Word (DOCX) to PDF
docx-to-pdf.description: Convert a Word document to PDF: headings, paragraphs, lists and simple tables.
docx-to-pdf.note: FourTout keeps the content and its structure — headings, paragraphs, bold, italics, lists, simple tables — but not the Word layout: columns, floating boxes, headers and footers, specific fonts and images may differ or be missing. For a pixel-perfect result, export to PDF from Word or LibreOffice.

document-compare.name: Compare two documents
document-compare.description: Compare the content of two documents — PDF, Word, text, Markdown or HTML — even in different formats, line by line and word by word.
document-compare.note: The comparison is about the text, not the layout: it tells you what changed in the content, even across two different formats. A scanned PDF must first go through “Scanned PDF to searchable PDF”.

text-encoding-detect.name: Detect a text file's encoding
text-encoding-detect.description: Identify a file's encoding, byte order mark and line-ending convention, with the actual level of certainty.
text-encoding-detect.note: Apart from a byte order mark, no file declares its encoding: detection remains an educated guess, and FourTout shows its real certainty rather than a misleading verdict.

text-encoding-convert.name: Convert a text file's encoding
text-encoding-convert.description: Switch from one encoding to another — UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE, Windows-1252, Latin-1 — without silently losing a character.
text-encoding-convert.note: If the target encoding can't represent some characters, the conversion is refused and those characters are listed. Replacement only happens if you explicitly ask for it.

subtitle-edit.name: Edit subtitles
subtitle-edit.description: Convert between SRT and WebVTT, shift timestamps, merge two files, check and repair.
subtitle-edit.note: Whatever is mechanically safe is fixed (order, numbering, line endings); overlaps are flagged but never shortened automatically.

archive-create.name: Create an archive
archive-create.description: Compress files or folders into ZIP, 7z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.XZ, keeping the folder structure.
archive-create.note: The 7z created here isn't encrypted: for a password-protected archive, use “Password-protected archive”, whose AES-256 ZIP opens with 7-Zip, WinRAR, Keka and Windows Explorer.

archive-extract.name: Extract an archive
archive-extract.description: Decompress a ZIP, 7z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.XZ archive into the folder of your choice.
archive-extract.note: No file is ever written outside the chosen folder: entries whose path climbs up (“../”), absolute paths and symbolic links are refused and listed. RAR isn't supported.

archive-encrypted.name: Password-protected archive
archive-encrypted.description: Create or open a password-encrypted archive.
archive-encrypted.note: WinZip AES-256 encryption: the archive opens with 7-Zip, WinRAR, PeaZip, Keka and Windows Explorer. The legacy “ZipCrypto”, crackable in seconds, is never used. File names, however, stay readable without the password — a limitation of the ZIP format.

file-hash.name: Compute a hash
file-hash.description: Get the SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1 or MD5 of one or more files, whatever their size.

file-verify-hash.name: Verify a hash
file-verify-hash.description: Compare a file's hash with the one published by its source.

file-find-duplicates.name: Find duplicate files
file-find-duplicates.description: Detect duplicates in a folder by content, not by name.

file-compare.name: Compare two files
file-compare.description: Check whether two files are identical, byte by byte or line by line.

file-bulk-rename.name: Bulk rename
file-bulk-rename.description: Rename hundreds of files with a pattern, numbering or a regex.

file-clean-names.name: Clean up file names
file-clean-names.description: Remove accents, spaces and problematic characters from file names.

file-organize.name: Organize a folder
file-organize.description: Automatically sort files by extension, date or type.

folder-size.name: Analyze folder space
folder-size.description: See what's really taking up space: biggest files, biggest subfolders, breakdown by type.
folder-size.note: Only file system metadata is read: file contents are never opened. Unreadable folders are flagged rather than counted as zero, and symbolic links aren't followed (their target would be counted twice).

file-secure-delete.name: Secure delete
file-secure-delete.description: Overwrite a file's contents before deleting it, making software recovery very unlikely.
file-secure-delete.note: Hardened software erasure, not physical destruction: on an SSD, memory card, Btrfs/ZFS/APFS, or when snapshots and backups exist, no software can guarantee every earlier copy is gone.

file-split.name: Split a large file
file-split.description: Cut a large file into numbered pieces, with a verification manifest.

file-join.name: Reassemble a file
file-join.description: Rebuild a file from its .part001 pieces, with hash verification.

folder-tree.name: Generate a folder tree
folder-tree.description: Produce a text tree of a folder, ready to paste into a README.

file-info.name: Inspect a file
file-info.description: Real type detected from its signature, extension consistency, encoding, dates, hashes and first bytes.
file-info.note: The type shown comes from the first bytes, not the extension: a “.jpg” that contains a PNG is reported as such. Nothing is renamed automatically — fixing it stays an action you ask for.

folder-compare.name: Compare two folders
folder-compare.description: See what's identical, changed, or present on only one side between two folder trees.
folder-compare.note: Quick mode compares type and size without reading anything: two files of the same size are called “probably identical”. Only reliable mode confirms equality by content — and it only reads files of the same size, since a different size is enough to conclude.

folder-sync.name: Sync folders
folder-sync.description: Update a destination from a source, with a detailed plan before anything is written.
folder-sync.note: One-way sync: the source is the reference and the destination follows it. Nothing is written until you've read the plan. Mirror mode deletes from the destination whatever no longer exists in the source, and asks for a separate confirmation.

file-search.name: Search in files
file-search.description: Find files by name, type, size or date — or by the text they contain.
file-search.note: On-demand search: FourTout doesn't index anything in the background and keeps nothing between searches. Content search only opens what genuinely looks like text — a binary is never interpreted as text.

file-preview.name: Preview a file
file-preview.description: Open any file without its app: text, image, PDF, audio, video, archive or raw bytes.
file-preview.note: The preview is chosen from the actual content, not the extension. Large text files are only partly loaded, and the preview says so.

file-hex-edit.name: Hex editor
file-hex-edit.description: Read and fix a file's bytes, window by window, without ever loading it whole.
file-hex-edit.note: A deliberately limited editor: no binary templates, no scripting, no inserting or deleting bytes — only in-place fixes that never change the file size. By default, the result is saved to a new file.

folder-backup.name: Back up a folder
folder-backup.description: Copy a folder with a hash manifest, so you can verify and restore it later.
folder-backup.note: Transparent format: a “donnees” folder that mirrors your folder structure, and a readable “manifeste.json”. No proprietary container — your files stay accessible even without FourTout. This isn't a versioned backup: each backup is a full, dated copy.

folder-restore.name: Restore a backup
folder-restore.description: Verify a FourTout backup, then put it back without overwriting anything you didn't choose.
folder-restore.note: Integrity is checked before anything is written: a damaged file in the backup is named, not silently restored. Restoring never deletes anything in the destination.

checksum-manifest.name: Create a checksum manifest
checksum-manifest.description: Produce a .sha256 file listing the hash of every file in a folder.
checksum-manifest.note: The text format produced is sha256sum's: it can be checked with system tools on any machine. MD5 and SHA-1 are still offered to verify old hashes, but are flagged as unsuitable for security use.

checksum-verify.name: Verify a checksum manifest
checksum-verify.description: Compare a folder with a checksum file: intact, modified, missing or unreadable, file by file.
checksum-verify.note: A manifest is data, not an instruction: an entry that would climb out of the verified folder (“../”, absolute path) is refused and listed, never followed.

hmac.name: Compute an HMAC
hmac.description: Sign a text or file with a secret key, using HMAC-SHA-256 or SHA-512.
hmac.note: The key is never saved, logged or added to recents: it's used for the calculation, then discarded. It's cleared from the screen as soon as you leave the tool.

file-compress.name: Compress a file (GZ, XZ)
file-compress.description: Shrink a single file into .gz or .xz — without making it an archive.
file-compress.note: “.gz” and “.xz” hold a single file, with no folder name or structure. To compress several files and keep their organization, use “Create an archive” with its TAR.GZ or TAR.XZ format.

file-decompress.name: Decompress a file (GZ, XZ)
file-decompress.description: Get back the original file from a .gz or .xz.
file-decompress.note: A “.tar.gz” contains a folder tree: use “Extract an archive” instead, which will restore it. Here, a .tar.gz would simply give back the .tar.

archive-inspect.name: Inspect an archive
archive-inspect.description: List an archive's contents without extracting it: paths, sizes, compression ratios, suspicious entries.
archive-inspect.note: Nothing is decompressed: only the archive's table of contents is read. Entries whose path would escape the extraction folder are flagged before you even consider extracting.

archive-test.name: Test an archive
archive-test.description: Check that an archive is intact by fully decompressing it, without writing anything to disk.
archive-test.note: The content is actually decompressed and its checksums verified — listing an archive would prove nothing, since only its header would be read. Nothing is written: the bytes are counted, then discarded.

universal-converter.name: Universal converter
universal-converter.description: Drop a file and FourTout suggests the possible conversions to compatible formats.
universal-converter.note: Suggested conversions are derived from the inputs and outputs declared by the tools in the registry: no separate table to maintain, and never a conversion offered without a tool behind it.

json-tools.name: JSON — format and validate
json-tools.description: Indent, minify and validate JSON, with a precise error message.

xml-format.name: XML — format
xml-format.description: Indent and validate an XML document.

yaml-format.name: YAML — format and convert
yaml-format.description: Format YAML and convert it to or from JSON.

sql-format.name: SQL — format
sql-format.description: Make a compact or generated SQL query readable.

base64.name: Base64 — encode and decode
base64.description: Convert text to Base64 and back, including base64url.

url-encode.name: URL — encode and decode
url-encode.description: Encode or decode a URL and its parameters (percent-encoding).

jwt-decode.name: JWT — decode
jwt-decode.description: Read a JWT's header and payload, without sending it anywhere.
jwt-decode.note: The token is decoded locally: it never leaves your machine.

uuid-generate.name: Generate UUIDs
uuid-generate.description: Create unique v4 or v7 identifiers, one at a time or in batches.

regex-tester.name: Regular expression tester
regex-tester.description: Test a regex live and see the matches and groups.

timestamp-convert.name: Unix timestamp
timestamp-convert.description: Convert a timestamp to a readable date and back, with time zones.

hash-text.name: Hash a text
hash-text.description: Compute the MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512 of a string.

qr-generate.name: Generate a QR code
qr-generate.description: Create a QR code for a URL, text, contact or Wi-Fi network.

qr-read.name: Read a QR code
qr-read.description: Decode a QR code from an image or screenshot.

number-base-convert.name: Convert hex, decimal, binary
number-base-convert.description: Switch between bases: binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal.

code-diff.name: Code diff
code-diff.description: Compare two blocks of code with additions and deletions highlighted.

web-minify.name: Minify HTML, CSS, JS
web-minify.description: Reduce code size by removing whitespace and comments.

web-beautify.name: Format HTML, CSS, JS
web-beautify.description: Re-indent minified or badly formatted code to make it readable.

cron-helper.name: Cron helper
cron-helper.description: Build a cron expression and explain it in plain language.

toml-format.name: TOML — format and validate
toml-format.description: Check a TOML file and rewrite it in a canonical form.
toml-format.note: Reformatting rebuilds the document from its data: comments and the original ordering are lost. Validation, on the other hand, changes nothing.

base32.name: Base32 — encode and decode
base32.description: Convert text to Base32 and back, per RFC 4648.

sqlite-explorer.name: SQLite database — explore
sqlite-explorer.description: Open a SQLite database read-only: schema, data, queries, CSV export.
sqlite-explorer.note: Strictly read-only explorer: the database is opened read-only and no query can modify it.

unit-length.name: Converter — length
unit-length.description: Meters, kilometers, miles, feet, inches, nautical miles.

unit-volume.name: Converter — volume
unit-volume.description: Liters, milliliters, gallons, pints, cups, spoons.

unit-area.name: Converter — area
unit-area.description: Square meters, hectares, acres, square feet.

unit-data.name: Converter — digital storage
unit-data.description: Bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, and their binary equivalents (KiB, MiB).

calc-percentage.name: Percentage calculations
calc-percentage.description: Percentage of a number, change, discount, VAT, share of a total.

calc-proportion.name: Rule of three
calc-proportion.description: Solve a proportion: if A is B, what is C?

calc-date-difference.name: Date calculations
calc-date-difference.description: Number of days between two dates; add or subtract a duration.

calc-duration.name: Duration calculations
calc-duration.description: Add and subtract hours, minutes and seconds.

calc-age.name: Calculate an age
calc-age.description: Exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth.

calc-scientific.name: Scientific calculator
calc-scientific.description: Advanced operations: powers, roots, trigonometry, logarithms.

calc-currency.name: Currency converter
calc-currency.description: Convert amounts between currencies with recent rates.
calc-currency.note: The only FourTout tool that needs the Internet, solely to fetch today's rates. The last known rates are reused offline.

calc-timezone.name: Convert between time zones
calc-timezone.description: Convert one local time to another, daylight saving time included.
calc-timezone.note: Offsets come from the system's time zone database, for the requested date: clock changes are respected, and ambiguous or nonexistent times are flagged.

calc-bandwidth.name: Calculate bandwidth
calc-bandwidth.description: Work out an average rate from an amount of data and a duration.

calc-transfer-time.name: Calculate transfer time
calc-transfer-time.description: Estimate how long a transfer takes from a size and a rate.
calc-transfer-time.note: Theoretical calculation: size ÷ rate. It ignores protocol overhead, latency and congestion — a real transfer always takes longer.

calc-interest.name: Calculate interest
calc-interest.description: Simple or compound interest, with optional regular deposits.
calc-interest.note: A math tool, not financial advice: taxes, inflation and fees aren't taken into account.

network-ping.name: Ping
network-ping.description: Check whether a host responds, and how fast.
network-ping.note: Sends real ICMP packets, four by default. If the system refuses ICMP sockets, the tool says so rather than measuring something else.

network-ports.name: Test ports
network-ports.description: See which TCP ports on a host accept a connection.
network-ports.note: One host, at most 256 ports per run, using ordinary TCP connections. This isn't a scanner: no stealth, no service detection, no vulnerability search.

network-lan.name: Discover local network devices
network-lan.description: List the machines that show up on your subnet.
network-lan.note: Limited to the directly connected subnet and to 256 addresses. The exact range is shown before anything is sent, and nothing goes out without confirmation.

file-diagnose.name: Diagnose a file
file-diagnose.description: Understand what a file really is, and what it's missing.
file-diagnose.note: The original file is never modified. FourTout analyzes the internal structure of ZIP, PDF, PNG and JPEG files, and says so plainly for other formats.

archive-repair.name: Damaged ZIP archive
archive-repair.description: Diagnose an unreadable archive and recover what it still contains.
archive-repair.note: Recovers by scanning local headers, even without a central directory. Entries whose data is truncated are reported as lost — they're never reconstructed. The original archive isn't touched.

pdf-repair.name: Damaged PDF
pdf-repair.description: Diagnose an unreadable PDF and repair it when the fix can be proven.
pdf-repair.note: Every file produced is reopened by the PDF engine and its pages counted: if the engine rejects it, the repair is reported as failed and the file deleted. Rewriting invalidates any digital signature.

image-repair.name: Damaged image
image-repair.description: Diagnose a damaged PNG or JPEG and save the readable pixels.
image-repair.note: A wrong checksum is never recomputed, and the missing rows of a truncated image are never invented. Visual recovery re-encodes the decoded pixels: it saves the picture, not the file.

disk-inspect.name: Inspect disks and partitions
disk-inspect.description: See the system's disks, partitions, volumes and health indicators.
disk-inspect.note: Read-only, no exceptions: FourTout can't partition, format, mount, clone or erase a disk. Detailed health indicators depend on `smartctl`, which FourTout doesn't bundle.

password-generate.name: Generate a password
password-generate.description: Create strong passwords or memorable passphrases.

password-strength.name: Test password strength
password-strength.description: Estimate how long it would take to crack a password, offline.
password-strength.note: The analysis is entirely local: the password you type is never transmitted.

file-encrypt.name: Encrypt files
file-encrypt.description: Protect files with a password using modern encryption.

file-decrypt.name: Decrypt files
file-decrypt.description: Get back the content of a file encrypted with FourTout.

metadata-strip-any.name: Remove a file's metadata
metadata-strip-any.description: Clean out author, dates, device and location before sharing a document.
